parts.name: Root
parts.description: Owns the collection and the split between the two sides. `items` is everything; `value` is the ordered list of keys on the right, and the left is the rest.

props.name: items
props.description: The whole collection, in the order the left-hand list shows it.

props.name: getKey
props.description: Identity of an item. Defaults to its `id` field.

props.name: value
props.description: Keys on the right, in order. Two-way by default — use `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial right-hand keys, for when `value` is not supplied.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Opt into fully controlled state: the component stops writing back to `value` and
only reports through `onChange`, so the parent can reject a move by not flowing
the new value back down. Off by default, because `bind:value` — the common case —
needs the write-back to work at all.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called after a move, with the new value and what moved.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys that cannot be moved off the side they are on.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the wrapper element.

props.name: children
props.description: The two lists, the move buttons, and anything else the layout needs.

parts.name: Source
parts.description: The left-hand list: every item that is not in `value`. A `role="listbox"` with multiple selection, named by `label`.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name of the list. Also the name the move buttons and the live region use,
which is why it is a string rather than only an `aria-label` pass-through: "Move
selected to Selected" reads far better than "move right", and survives RTL.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible heading, when the list already has one on screen.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered for each item on this side.

props.name: emptyPlaceholder
props.description: Shown when the side has no items. Nothing is rendered when omitted.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description: Renders only the rows near the viewport. See `ListBox`'s own `virtualizer`.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the list element.

parts.name: Target
parts.description: The right-hand list, rendered in `value` order so items keep the sequence they were moved in.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name of the list. Also the name the move buttons and the live region use,
which is why it is a string rather than only an `aria-label` pass-through: "Move
selected to Selected" reads far better than "move right", and survives RTL.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible heading, when the list already has one on screen.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered for each item on this side.

props.name: emptyPlaceholder
props.description: Shown when the side has no items. Nothing is rendered when omitted.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description: Renders only the rows near the viewport. See `ListBox`'s own `virtualizer`.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the list element.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: One row, on whichever side it currently lives. Double clicking sends it to the other list; Enter toggles selection, as in any multi-select listbox.

props.name: item
props.description: The item this row renders. Its key comes from the Root's `getKey`.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text used for typeahead. Falls back to the row's text content.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the row.

props.name: children
props.description: Row content.

parts.name: MoveSelected
parts.description: Moves the selected items of the opposite list to `to`. Disabled while that list has nothing movable selected.

props.name: to
props.description: Which list the items go to.

props.name: children
props.description: Button content — an arrow, a label, whatever the layout calls for.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the button.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

parts.name: MoveAll
parts.description: Moves every movable item of the opposite list to `to`, selected or not. Items in `disabledKeys` stay where they are.

props.name: to
props.description: Which list the items go to.

props.name: children
props.description: Button content — an arrow, a label, whatever the layout calls for.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the button.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

parts.name: Status
parts.description: Visually-hidden live region that announces each move. Without it a move is silent to a screen reader.

props.name: formatMessage
props.description: Build the announced message from the completed move.

dataAttributes.name: data-transfer-list-status
dataAttributes.description: Identifies this live region — every Button ships one of its own.
